summary: SK Telecom filed a Form 6-K reporting the disposal of 1,061 treasury common shares on August 31, 2026, at 94,200 KRW per share, totaling 99,946,200 KRW, to officers and employees through SK Securities. The disposal follows an initial board decision reported August 27, 2026. Post-disposal, the company holds 1,731,081 treasury shares representing 0.81% of total shares. The transaction is a minor capital return mechanism, likely part of an employee share plan. Watch for further treasury share sales or potential capital return initiatives.
